breakdown.description: The Fox equation is written in reciprocal absolute temperature, so the component T_g values must be converted to K.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly instructed to apply the Fox equation using degrees Celsius. The ground truth provides the values in Kelvin, indicating the correct unit. The agent correctly identified this error, converted the temperatures to Kelvin (100°C to 373 K and 20°C to 293 K), and explicitly stated that the calculation must use absolute temperature before proceeding with the correct Kelvin values.
